b02c3d4e-5f6a-7890-1bcd-ef0123456002.name: Plan and design step

informationProduced.purpose: Plan specific changes to an existing framework artifact (template, step, or process) by reviewing the update description, loading the baseline analysis, prompting the user about backward compatibility, checking for active consumers, and producing an update-plan.md document for approval.
useCases: Planning updates to templates (steps, parameters, flow, documentation)
Planning updates to steps (substeps, guidance, dependencies, references)
Any workflow that modifies an existing framework artifact and needs an approved plan

typeSpecificBehavior.template: Changes to steps array, parameters, metadata, flow diagram; checks active processes
typeSpecificBehavior.step: Changes to substeps, guidance, dependencies, references; checks referencing templates
typeSpecificBehavior.process: Changes to state, configuration; checks parent/child relationships

dependencies.requiredFromPreviousStep: Artifact analysis in memory.json (currentStructure from analyze-current-artifact-state)

decisionsMade: REVISED: Category changed from template to common (generalized step)
REVISED: Name changed from plan-template-updates to plan-artifact-updates (per user feedback)
